FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm install --global pnpm@9.15.9
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
ENV VITE_API_URL=/api
RUN NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=384 pnpm run build
WORKDIR /app/server
RUN npm ci
RUN npx --no-install prisma generate
# Extract only original category defaults, without running the destructive demo seed.
RUN node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import vm from "node:vm"; const source=fs.readFileSync("prisma/seed.ts","utf8"); const literal=source.match(/const DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES = (\[[\s\S]*?\n\])/)[1]; fs.writeFileSync("categories.json",JSON.stringify(vm.runInNewContext("("+literal+")",Object.create(null),{timeout:1000})));'
# Deployment adapter: existing routers, atomic non-destructive initialization, static UI and constrained PDF streaming.
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import path from "node:path";' 'import fs from "node:fs/promises";' 'import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";' 'import { prisma } from "./src/prisma.ts";' 'import auth from "./src/routes/auth.ts";' 'import applications from "./src/routes/applications.ts";' 'import documents from "./src/routes/documents.ts";' 'import clients from "./src/routes/clients.ts";' 'import notifications from "./src/routes/notifications.ts";' 'import admin from "./src/routes/admin.ts";' 'for (const name of ["JWT_SECRET", "APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"]) if (!process.env[name]) throw new Error("Missing required environment: "+name);' 'const categories = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(new URL("./categories.json", import.meta.url), "utf8"));' 'const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD, 12);' 'async function initialize() {' '  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {' '    const owners = (await tx.admin.findMany()).filter(a => a.username.toLowerCase() === "sindiswa-cell");' '    if (owners.length > 1) throw new Error("Ambiguous owner records; manual recovery required");' '    if (!owners.length && await tx.client.findUnique({where:{username:"sindiswa-cell"}})) throw new Error("Owner username already belongs to a client; manual recovery required");' '    await tx.systemSetting.upsert({where:{id:1},update:{},create:{id:1,allowRegistration:true,emailNotifications:true,maxUploadMb:5,maintenanceMode:false,privacyNotice:"iHOPED processes personal information in line with POPIA. Data is used solely to assess housing assistance applications and will not be shared without lawful basis."}});' '    for (const cat of categories) await tx.documentCategory.upsert({where:{id:cat.id},update:{},create:{...cat,enabled:true}});' '    if (!owners.length) await tx.admin.create({data:{username:"sindiswa-cell",fullName:"System Administrator",email:"sindiswa-cell@localhost.invalid",passwordHash,mustChangePassword:false,active:true}});' '  }, {timeout:20000});' '}' 'for (let attempt=0;;attempt++) {' '  try { await initialize(); break; } catch (error) {' '    if (attempt >= 4 || !["P2034","P1008","P2028","P2002"].includes(error.code)) throw error;' '    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250*(attempt+1)));' '  }' '}' 'const app = express();' 'app.disable("x-powered-by");' 'app.use(express.json({limit:"2mb"}));' 'app.use((req,res,next) => {' '  res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff");' '  const json = res.json;' '  const adapt = value => {' '    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(adapt);' '    if (value && typeof value === "object") {' '      const result = {...value};' '      for (const key of Object.keys(result)) {' '        if (key === "previewUrl" && typeof result[key] === "string") result[key] = result[key].replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+(\/uploads\/)/,"$1");' '        else result[key] = adapt(result[key]);' '      }' '      return result;' '    }' '    return value;' '  };' '  res.json = function(value) { return json.call(this, adapt(value)); };' '  next();' '});' 'const uploadRoot = "/app/.data/uploads";' 'app.use("/uploads", async (req,res,next) => {' '  res.setHeader("Content-Security-Policy", "sandbox; default-src '\''none'\''; frame-ancestors '\''self'\''");' '  res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");' '  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/pdf");' '  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", "inline; filename=\"document.pdf\"");' '  let handle;' '  try {' '    const name = decodeURIComponent(req.path);' '    const file = path.resolve(uploadRoot, "."+name);' '    if (!file.startsWith(uploadRoot+"/")) return res.status(404).end();' '    handle = await fs.open(file,"r");' '    const stat = await handle.stat();' '    const head = Buffer.alloc(5);' '    await handle.read(head,0,5,0);' '    if (!stat.isFile() || head.toString("ascii") !== "%PDF-") return res.status(415).end();' '    next();' '  } catch { res.status(404).end(); } finally { if (handle) await handle.close(); }' '}, express.static(uploadRoot, {fallthrough:false,setHeaders(res) {res.setHeader("Content-Type","application/pdf");}}));' 'app.get("/api/health", (_req,res) => res.json({ok:true,service:"ihoped-api"}));' 'app.use("/api/auth",auth);' 'app.use("/api/applications",applications);' 'app.use("/api/documents",documents);' 'app.use("/api/clients",clients);' 'app.use("/api/notifications",notifications);' 'app.use("/api/admin",admin);' 'app.use("/api",(_req,res) => res.status(404).json({error:"Not found"}));' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist"));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res) => res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'app.use((err,req,res,next) => {console.error(err); if (res.headersSent) return next(err); res.status(500).json({error:err.message || "Server error"});});' 'app.listen(4000,"0.0.0.0",() => console.log("iHOPED listening on port 4000"));' > deploy.mjs
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite
ENV PORT=4000
COPY --from=build /app/dist /app/dist
COPY --from=build /app/server /app/server
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data/uploads && rm -rf /app/server/uploads && ln -s /app/.data/uploads /app/server/uploads && chown -R 10001:10001 /app/.data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 4000
CMD ["/app/server/node_modules/.bin/tsx", "/app/server/deploy.mjs"]
